title: Basal Insulin in XDrip
body:
Hi All
Been using XDrip for a while now with a Miaomiao 2 on Oneplus 6 and have to say its changed my life

Well done developers...

Question, is there a way of adding Basal Night insulin in as at the moment its only Bolus

Fiasp bolus

Tresiba basal

comments.body:
Yea, that would be cool. My father also would appreciate that.
Cause a at the moment he sometimes adds two bolus treatments (that is one basal and one bolus) that result in an unrealistic effect time curve.
I don't think this exists yet. It can be done on Spike on iPhone.
I'd like to second this feature request - still have to log my basals (given with pen) separately (using a foreign app, then process their csv and upload to NS API).

It just seems a bit ridiculous that an app as good a xdrip cannot cope with bolus and basal. 
Surely someone out there must have a workaround that is relatively simple to grasp. 

Hey out there , What does everyone else do?? (I'm using libre and miaomiao )

Try installing the latest nightly and enable the `Multiple Insulins` preference option which is within the `Predictive Simulation Settings` - Due to a bug in the current version you may need to reboot your phone before this actually takes effect but then you can specify basal insulin as a treatment type if that is what you are looking for. I wouldn't advise trying to include injected basal insulin in to the prediction model via the option as there is no model for this.

Fantastic, that's nearly what we are looking.. I'm actually on tresiba 48 hour basal which is not on the list yet, but hey I will try with lantus. 
I added lantus but it squews the profile.
Has anyone checked out how they do it in Glimp it has been in there for a few years and seems to work well.

I've been using Glimp for a while, and also adopted their scheme. IIRC there's the insulin value, a notes entry (which contains "Bolus" or "Basal"), and a treatment type that's "None" for Basal.
I'm on the train now, but my Contour2Nightscout repo has a script that creates a valid json...

Update: Here's a snippet of treatments read back from a Nightscout instance:
```
{"_id":"5db15609b9e90954c1a196f7","created_at":"2019-10-24T07:42:00.000Z","eventType":"<none>","glucoseType":"Finger","glucose":111,"units":"mg/dl","enteredBy":"Glimp","utcOffset":0,"carbs":null,"insulin":null},
{"_id":"5db15829b9e90954c1a198d8","created_at":"2019-10-24T04:20:00.000Z","eventType":"<none>","insulin":6,"notes":"Basal","enteredBy":"Glimp","utcOffset":0,"carbs":null},
{"_id":"5db1585eb9e90954c1a19900","created_at":"2019-10-23T20:00:00.000Z","eventType":"<none>","insulin":3,"notes":"Basal","enteredBy":"Glimp","utcOffset":0,"carbs":null}
```
(line-feeds added for readability, extra stuff stripped)
Apparently the `eventType` doesn't matter much?

I've been using the `Multiple Insulins` it works well for input but to throws off the insulin on board graph.
Would be great to have different line graphs per insulin type.
I don't have any experience with apps but I'm a responsible python programmer, any tips on getting started contributing to this project I would love to help

I am probably doing something incorrectly but I am wondering if a basal injectiion should be shown in NS ? I'm reallty not sure if I am entering my basal injection (basaglar) correctly. In the morning I dose with Basaglar & novorapid but only the novorapid appears in Nitecout. I cuurently add a note so that I have a record of the injection.

There have been lots of updates since this issue was opened.
Would you please update if this is still missing?

@korkats 
There seems to be a strong overlap with #1153.
I hope you don't mind me closing this.  But, if you disagree, we can reopen it.
Thanks
